name: lemeng.business_collection_coupon.day
_note: lemeng.business_collection_coupon.day —— 营业收款报表-卡券汇总 的单块子管线（由父管线 ctl.foreach 驱动，不单独调度）。
生成器：scripts/lemeng/gen-business-collection.mjs（勿手改；改列集改生成器再重跑）。
骨架克隆自 lemeng.branch_indicator.day.json，身份门与分块在父管线。
① 请求：POST nhsoft.report.ai.businesscollection.coupon.find，一天一窗（BIZDAY=BIZDAY），branch_nums 由父管线按 100 家切好传入。
② 网关闸（denv）：code != 0 即拒写；10001=单请求超 100 家，10003=名单含本凭据无权限的店号。
③ 截断闸（gtc/dtc）：result.total_count 必须等于 result.rows 长度——接口不分页，不等即被截断。
④ 逐门店左连接（n）：以请求里的门店清单为左表，源端没返回的门店 matched=false ⇒
整天全空由父级 gall/dall 裁决，单块空只写 1 行占位（branch_num=NULL）保证分块到齐判据成立。

properties.sql:
SELECT CAST(code AS INTEGER) AS code, CAST(msg AS VARCHAR) AS msg
FROM read_json_auto('/workspace/.duckle-raw/business_collection_coupon-${ITER_ITEM_BATCH_ID}-c${ITER_ITEM_CHUNK_NO}.json')
WHERE CAST(code AS INTEGER) <> 0

properties.message: business_collection_coupon 网关非 0 code（{rows} 条）：chunk ${ITER_ITEM_CHUNK_NO}/${ITER_ITEM_N_CHUNKS} bizday=${ITER_ITEM_BIZDAY}；10001=单请求超 100 家，10003=名单里有本凭据无权限的店号。raw 见 /workspace/.duckle-raw/business_collection_coupon-${ITER_ITEM_BATCH_ID}-c${ITER_ITEM_CHUNK_NO}.json

properties.sql:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT CAST(json_extract_string(CAST(content AS JSON), '$.result.total_count') AS BIGINT) AS total_count,
         CAST(json_array_length(json_extract(CAST(content AS JSON), '$.result.rows')) AS BIGINT) AS n_rows
  FROM read_text('/workspace/.duckle-raw/business_collection_coupon-${ITER_ITEM_BATCH_ID}-c${ITER_ITEM_CHUNK_NO}.json')
) t
WHERE t.total_count IS DISTINCT FROM t.n_rows

properties.message: 网关自相矛盾：total_count 与返回行数不等（{rows} 条）——响应被截断，拒绝写湖。raw 见 /workspace/.duckle-raw/business_collection_coupon-${ITER_ITEM_BATCH_ID}-c${ITER_ITEM_CHUNK_NO}.json

properties.sql:
SELECT CAST(req.branch_num AS INTEGER) AS branch_num,
       CAST(input.branch_code AS VARCHAR) AS branch_code,
       CAST(input.branch_name AS VARCHAR) AS branch_name,
       CAST(input.branch_region_num AS INTEGER) AS branch_region_num,
       CAST(input.branch_region_name AS VARCHAR) AS branch_region_name,
       CAST(input.branch_type AS VARCHAR) AS branch_type,
       CAST(input.coupon_type_name AS VARCHAR) AS coupon_type_name,
       CAST(input.coupon_amount AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS coupon_amount,
       CAST(input.coupon_detail_sale_money AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS coupon_detail_sale_money,
       CAST(input.coupon_discount_money AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS coupon_discount_money,
       CAST(input.coupon_value AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS coupon_value,
       CAST(input.exchange_card_sale_money AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS exchange_card_sale_money,
       CAST(input.exchange_card_total_money AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS exchange_card_total_money,
       CAST(input.exchange_card_verification_count AS INTEGER) AS exchange_card_verification_count,
       input.branch_num IS NOT NULL AS matched
FROM (SELECT CAST(j.value AS BIGINT) AS branch_num FROM json_each('${ITER_ITEM_BRANCH_NUMS_JSON}') j) req
LEFT JOIN input ON CAST(input.branch_num AS BIGINT) = req.branch_num

SELECT '${ITER_ITEM_BATCH_ID}' AS batch_id,
       CAST(${ITER_ITEM_SYSTEM_BOOK} AS INTEGER) AS system_book,
       CAST('${ITER_ITEM_BIZDAY}' AS DATE) AS bizday,
       CAST(branch_num AS INTEGER) AS branch_num,
       CAST(branch_code AS VARCHAR) AS branch_code,
       CAST(branch_name AS VARCHAR) AS branch_name,
       CAST(branch_region_num AS INTEGER) AS branch_region_num,
       CAST(branch_region_name AS VARCHAR) AS branch_region_name,
       CAST(branch_type AS VARCHAR) AS branch_type,
       CAST(coupon_type_name AS VARCHAR) AS coupon_type_name,
       CAST(coupon_amount AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS coupon_amount,
       CAST(coupon_detail_sale_money AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS coupon_detail_sale_money,
       CAST(coupon_discount_money AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS coupon_discount_money,
       CAST(coupon_value AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS coupon_value,
       CAST(exchange_card_sale_money AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS exchange_card_sale_money,
       CAST(exchange_card_total_money AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS exchange_card_total_money,
       CAST(exchange_card_verification_count AS INTEGER) AS exchange_card_verification_count,
       CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS computed_at,
       CAST((SELECT count(DISTINCT branch_num) FROM input WHERE matched) AS INTEGER) AS chunk_n_matched
FROM input
WHERE matched
UNION ALL
SELECT '${ITER_ITEM_BATCH_ID}', CAST(${ITER_ITEM_SYSTEM_BOOK} AS INTEGER), CAST('${ITER_ITEM_BIZDAY}' AS DATE),
       CAST(NULL AS INTEGER),
       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR),
       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR),
       CAST(NULL AS INTEGER),
       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR),
       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR),
       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR),
       CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(20, 2)),
       CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(20, 2)),
       CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(20, 2)),
       CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(20, 2)),
       CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(20, 2)),
       CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(20, 2)),
       CAST(NULL AS INTEGER),
       CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMPTZ), CAST(0 AS INTEGER)
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM input WHERE matched)
